breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed to use the polar moment of inertia (J) for the Euler buckling calculation. The generated specification repeated this error by stating, 'Use the polar moment of inertia J = π * d^4 / 32 for the circular cross-section in the Euler buckling formula.' The correct approach, reflected in the ground truth, is to use the area moment of inertia (I), not J.
